tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground. The space the ribbon of light travels through.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Alternate section ground and form fields. One step up from void.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The one featured panel per section, menus, hovered rows. Elevation by surface, not shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px rules between sections and grid items. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text. 16:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, the struck 'before' value in an Outcome Shift. 6.3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Start of the Ribbon gradient (the logo's deep fold). Fill behind white text on Day; Flare button edge on Day. Not a text colour on Night.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Middle of the Ribbon. Links, focus rings, active states, chart series. 5:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: End of the Ribbon: the logo's glowing edge. Eyebrow labels, the light edge, icons when active, data highlights.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Primary call to action ONLY: one per screen. Text on it is on-flare. On Day add a 1px navy bottom edge.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a Flare button. 10.2:1.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Measured improvement label in an Outcome Shift. Never decoration.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive states only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Ship products that actually move the needle
styles.usage: Home hero h1 only. Scales to 44px on phones (clamp).

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Subscription & Billing Platform for US SaaS Company

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The 'after' value in an Outcome Shift. Tabular figures.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: From custom software to AI automation, we partner with ambitious teams to build technology that drives real business outcomes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Built a billing service layer between the product and Stripe that handles subscription lifecycle management.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in signal (Night) or volt (Day). One per section.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline block and its content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (64px on phones).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The ONE featured panel per section. Grid items stay square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the mobile sticky CTA bar only.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows: depth comes from surface steps. Glows are light, and appear only on interaction.

tokens.name: glow-signal
tokens.usage: Focus ring and hovered featured panel.

tokens.name: glow-flare
tokens.usage: Hovered Flare button (Night). The navy bottom edge on Day.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Reveals, menus, panel light edge sweep.

tokens.name: ease-light
tokens.usage: The only easing curve. Fast out, no bounce.
